# situation: on pull_request_target, a step reads the branch names with
#   tj-actions/branch-names pinned to the commit of v7.0.6.
# reason: GHSA-8v8w-v8xg-79rf and GHSA-gq52-6phf-x2r6, which GitHub rates
#   critical, say that a branch name runs as code: GHSA-8v8w-v8xg-79rf, the
#   head ref in a run step of the action; GHSA-gq52-6phf-x2r6, the name that
#   the action escapes and unescapes again by eval printf and writes to its
#   outputs, which a run step of the caller runs (the example
#   step-output-remote-action.ghsl-2025-087 of code-injection has that
#   form).
# attack-value: the name of the pull request's branch = "a$(echo${IFS}PWNED)"
# attack-run-behavior: the action's script runs the command in the branch
#   name, with the token and the secrets of the job of the base repository.
# advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gq52-6phf-x2r6
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: tj-actions/branch-names@ab304d8562e2f137165e1d930e6d22d431189074 # v7.0.6
